proves: all three upstream plugin forms mount live through the workspace chain: object (name/inject/apply), function (export default), and class (extends Service from @deepseek-ai/cordis) (plugin.forms/form.mounted)
the class form's static inject ['tools'] orders the load and the service answers through the cordis resolver (plugin.forms/forms.live)

plugin config: the exported Schemastery schema validates inside ctx.plugin — explicit value, schema default, invalid config fails the mount LOUD with the adoption rolled back (config.validated/default/invalid)

config HMR (fiber.update): a validated update RESTARTS the fiber in place — no unmount, no epoch bump — and an INVALID update refuses while the old config keeps running (config.updated + config.update-invalid)

the event system: ALL FIVE dispatch modes (emit, bail, serial, waterfall, parallel) + the prepend option + once self-detach + the global filter bypass; ctx.on detaches on unmount (events.observed + events.detached)
the tutorial-verbatim greet tool (defineTool) executes through the real ToolRuntime under an independent tools/result observer (policy.denied + tool.greeted)

execution policy: ALL THREE waterfalls — tools/pre-execute denies, tools/post-execute REWRITES the canonical value (finalization re-renders content from value) and BLOCKS with corrective feedback, both lifting on unmount; ctx.tools.guard refuses monotonically (policy.denied + tool.greeted)
background work: ctx.jobs.start/wait/read/kill against the real LocalJobRegistry, including the compliant-producer cancel-settles-done contract (jobs.lifecycle)
nested fibers + provide: a child mounted through ctx.plugin disposes recursively with its parent; ctx.provide answers (nested.provided + nested.recursive)
the dependency cascade: provider unload disposes the dependent; service restore reloads it (cascade.disposed + cascade.reloaded)
the PENDING diagnosis: a mount whose inject names a missing service refuses with the diagnosis and rolls its adoption back (pending.refused)
LLM adapters: a workspace-authored LlmAdapter subclass serves its provider through the real LlmRuntime waterfall (llm.streamed)
unload/reload/boot-list: fiber.dispose runs the cleanups, edited source re-links under ?e=1, the boot-list mounts exactly the enabled rows (unload.effects + reload.edited + bootlist.mounted)

the creation flow's negative legs refuse as structured in-band values, never throws: bad syntax and a plugin-less export refuse at 'linked' with the registry enable rolled back, an unknown template kind is refused by plugin_create itself with the supported list, and a same-name remount refuses at 'context' without disturbing the live fiber (create.refused + create.kindrefused)
the setInterval discipline warn: an authored source calling setInterval still writes and answers with the non-blocking warn riding the result, while a clean template draws none (create.warned)
